$comment: Generated by `npm run catalog` from src/renderer/src/plugins/*/manifest.ts. Do not edit.

plugins.name: Atmos
plugins.description: Atmospheric synth: morphing wavetables, granular textures, tuned air, shimmer reverb.

plugins.name: Bassline
plugins.description: All-in-one bass instrument: 303 acid with accent & slide, analog/Moog, 808 & sub, reese, wobble, FM, plucks and physically modelled finger/pick/slap/fretless/upright basses.

plugins.name: Bitcrusher
plugins.description: Lo-fi bit depth and sample-rate reduction, from subtle grit to 8-bit crunch.

plugins.name: Chiptune
plugins.description: NES / Game Boy style 8-bit synth: pulse, triangle, noise and GB wave channels with Famitracker-style sequences, sweep, vibrato, arpeggio and a retro drum mode.

plugins.name: Chorus
plugins.description: Lush multi-voice stereo chorus: thickens synths, guitars and vocals.

plugins.name: Compressor
plugins.description: Smooth feed-forward compressor with soft knee, auto make-up, parallel mix and side-chain input.

plugins.name: Concerto
plugins.description: Sampled Baroque & Classical orchestra: strings, winds, brass, harpsichord, organs, choir, timpani, harp — articulations with keyswitches, legato, layered ensembles, hall reverb and orchestral seating.

plugins.name: Delay
plugins.description: Tempo-synced stereo / ping-pong delay with filtered, warm feedback.

plugins.name: Distortion
plugins.description: Warm to wild: soft/hard clip, tube, fuzz, wavefold and rectify, 4x oversampled.

plugins.name: Classic Drum Machines
plugins.description: Classic drum machines: 808, 909, 606, CR-78, Simmons, Linn, LM-1, DMX, Drumulator, 707, SP-12 and more. GM key map (36 kick, 38 snare, 39 clap, 42 hat...).

plugins.name: Filter
plugins.description: Resonant 12/24 dB multimode filter with drive and a syncable LFO for sweeps and wobbles.

plugins.name: Flanger
plugins.description: Jet-plane flanger: short swept delay with positive or negative feedback.

plugins.name: Gate
plugins.description: Noise gate with hold, range and side-chain input. Tightens drums, removes hiss and bleed.

plugins.name: Hexa
plugins.description: 6-operator FM synthesizer in the spirit of the DX7: 32 algorithms, loads DX7 .syx voices and cartridges.

plugins.name: Kabee
plugins.description: Guitar and bass pedalboard with a built-in amp and cabinet. Drag pedals to reorder, add/remove, tuner, gate learn.

plugins.name: Limiter
plugins.description: Look-ahead brickwall limiter: drive it for loudness, the ceiling is never exceeded.

plugins.name: Mosaic
plugins.description: Flagship workstation (Montage homage): up to 4 layered/split Parts per Performance across 8 engines — modelled pianos, EPs, tonewheel/pipe/combo organs with rotary, 6-op FM, plucked & bowed strings, analog/supersaw, formant choir and mallets — with Super Knob and an EQ/chorus/phaser/delay/reverb chain.

plugins.name: Multiband Compressor
plugins.description: Three-band compressor (LR4 crossovers) for controlling lows, mids and highs independently.

plugins.name: Parametric EQ
plugins.description: 7-band parametric EQ: drag the bands on the graph, wheel for Q. Shelves, cuts (12/24 dB), peaks and notches.

plugins.name: Phaser
plugins.description: Classic 4-12 stage phaser with feedback and stereo LFO offset.

plugins.name: Piano
plugins.description: Modelled acoustic & electric pianos: grands, uprights, felt, honky-tonk, CP-70, tine & reed EPs, toy, lo-fi and ambient patches, with sustain pedal.

plugins.name: Polygon
plugins.description: 4-tone 90s ROMpler: procedural virtual ROM, JV-style TVF/TVA, chorus and lo-fi digital reverb. The PS1 soundtrack sound.

plugins.name: Reverb
plugins.description: Lush, stable algorithmic reverb (8x8 FDN) with Room, Hall and Plate modes.

plugins.name: Sampler
plugins.description: Plays an audio sample, pitched by the piano roll.

plugins.name: Saturation
plugins.description: Musical warmth: tape, tube, transistor and console saturation with auto-gain so louder is not mistaken for better.

plugins.name: Stereo
plugins.description: Stereo utility: width, balance, channel swap, phase invert and mono bass, with a vectorscope.

plugins.name: Studio Drums
plugins.description: Sampled acoustic drum kits (multi-velocity, round robins), per-piece mixer, Latin percussion and a genre groove library.

plugins.name: Transient
plugins.description: Transient shaper: add punch or soften attacks, lengthen or tighten tails — no threshold to set.

plugins.name: Tremolo
plugins.description: Tremolo and auto-pan with tempo sync, smooth or choppy shapes and stereo offset.

plugins.name: Triple Osc
plugins.description: Three oscillators, a filter and an envelope. The default channel synth.

plugins.name: VocalTune
plugins.description: Simple auto-tune: pick a key and scale, set how hard it snaps. From gentle natural fixes to the robotic hard-tune effect.
